name: Entitlements
description:
What the platform permits a tenant: a set of limits and a set of features.

 An entitlement is what the platform permits; a subscription and a license
 are the two instruments that grant it. The cloud derives an organization's
 entitlements from its subscription's plan and the Enterprise server reads
 them from the signed claims of its license, so this message lives under
 platform, where both editions can import it, and never under billing,
 which only the cloud composes. Entitlements are derived on read and never
 stored as truth; there is no Entitlement resource kind.

fields.name: Limits
fields.description: The numeric limits in force. A limit that is absent is unlimited.

fields.name: Features
fields.description:
The features unlocked, each named once. A feature not listed is not
 unlocked; a gate switches over the closed vocabulary and treats every
 unknown value as locked.
